Circuit map - 3D

Drag to pan, right-drag to rotate, scroll to zoom. Click a white dot to select that premise.
Bin height = customers served, color = damage records. Circuit lines are colored by modeled risk for a typical protection zone under your storm. Your premise appears only as an approximate ~400 m cell. The street map underneath comes from the U.S. Geological Survey, so the tiles requested reveal the area you view to that service. It needs no API key.

Messages are sent to your back end as GET <url>?message=.... The back end answers with a premise number. This page then selects that premise, loads its weather, and sends the context JSON below back to the same URL. Leave the URL empty for demo mode (type a premise number such as P-0062).
